description: This file handles the rendering and processing of the Dynamic DNS editing page within a web-based router/configuration interface. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving existing DDNS service data, client-side JavaScript for form validation, user interaction, and AJAX submission, as well as HTML markup for the form layout and included header/footer components.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration parameters from a device configuration point using a key-value approach.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Returns list of instance IDs for a given object path, likely from device configuration.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches string values from device configuration paths.
